summary: Fix regex in _repo_from_git_remote (used by resolve_repo) to support GitHub repo names containing dots (e.g. "u.ai" from remotes like git@github.com:akasper/u.ai.git). Previously [^/.]+ stopped at first dot. Added parametrized regression test covering u.ai, dotted repos, plate.git, foo.git.git etc per #608 review feedback. Also documented .git trailer ambiguity in code comment and removed unnecessary RuntimeError wrapper in get_health.
migration_impact: None for downstream: auto repo detection (gh plate health, bootstrap, release, etc without --repo) now works for valid dotted repo names. No behavior change for standard names.
